title: UnifiedActivityInsight - Data API
description: Represents an insight related to a unified activity. Available for reports and dashboards in API version 59.0 and later.

ActivityId.description: ID of the unified activity that this insight is associated with. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
ActivityId.refers_to: UnifiedActivity, UnifiedEmail, UnifiedMeeting, UnifiedTask, UnifiedVideoCall, UnifiedVoiceCall

AggregatedKeywordOccurrences.description: The number of keyword occurrences that triggered this insight. This field is the sum of occurrences for all the attached UnifiedActivityInsightKeyword objects.

OwnerId.description: Optional. ID of the owner of the insight. Only user-scoped insights have owners (Scope=USER). This field is a relationship field.

Scope.description: The scope of the insight. Possible values are: ORG USER

special_access_rules: We’re retiring Einstein Activity Capture Activity 360 Reporting. Starting in Summer ’25, this object isn’t available with Einstein Activity Capture unless Activity 360 Reporting was enabled in your org in Spring ’25 or earlier. See Knowledge Article: Einstein Activity Capture Activity 360 Reporting, Activity Metrics, Activities Dashboard Upcoming Retirement
